description.p: TALOS is a completely local chess playing, training and analysis suite inspired by Lucas Chess. It plays standard chess plus ten FICS variants and two TALOS originals, trains you on 112,198 real Lucas Chess puzzles, keeps a spaced-repetition coach, and can swap the flat board for a 3D Battle Chess stage where the victims lose their heads.
It also ships Anarchess, a reconstruction of the tile-laying game by Dimitris Grammenos, and Anarchchess, the community's house rules as a real playable variant.
